title: Polished to Unpolished
description: Put polished andesite, diorite, granite, or tuff into a stonecutter and get the unpolished version back. Useful for getting stone variants from stonemason villagers.
body:
Put polished andesite, diorite, granite, or tuff into a stonecutter and get the unpolished version back. Useful for getting stone variants from stonemason villagers. 




I only tested in 26.1.2, but in theory it should work in any recent version.
